learning_outcomes.text: Understands of basic properties of fluids.
Learns and applies the methods used for analysis of hydraulic machinery, and force and energy exchange between fluid and the surfaces in content with fluids.
Understands basic properties and importance of pumps and turbines in engineering applications.
Learns and applies related system analysis, design and optimization of the methods.

syllabus_topics: Introduction, definition of power, tread, efficiency.
Pumps, axial flow and centrifugal pumps.
Pumps, axial flow and centrifugal pumps.
Operations applications and design analysis of pumps.
Water turbines, Pelton turbines, special type action and reaction turbines.
Thoma number, cavitation and its effect on reaction machinery.
The parallel and series connected centrifugal pumps.
bibliography: Su Makinaları Dersleri, C. Özgür, İ. T. Ü. Yayınları.
Turbomachinery Performance Analysis, R. I. Lewis, John Wiley & Sons Inc. Arnold.
